key.text: A printed poster of my research for a poster session, 36 by 48 inches, in color. I have the file ready and need one copy.

needs.why: To print a large 36 by 48 inch poster.

steps.title: Prepare the file
steps.detail: Save your poster design as a PDF file and check that the longest side measures 48 inches.

steps.title: Load your card
steps.detail: Load discretionary funds on your USC Card to pay for the printing.

steps.title: Bring the file
steps.detail: Bring your file to the Leavey computing center and ask ITS staff on site for help printing.

routes.process: Print a color poster on heavyweight coated paper

warnings.fix: Check that all images and figures in your file are high resolution before printing.
warnings.issue: The poster might look pixelated if images in your file have low resolution.

routes.fit_reason: This route is ideal because staff are on site to assist with printing large formats directly from your file. You can easily pay using your USC Card.

steps.title: Collect the poster
steps.detail: Pick up your printed poster from the lab once it is complete.
